The '''destruction of the ''Grappler''''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] and was the final battle of [[Strategic Warfare]].

==Prelude==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] used the [[Battle of RS-32|recent attack]] on [[RS-32]], which was used to secure [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag Pulse]] [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to [[Destruction of ZA-13|destroy]] [[ZA-13]], before it could be used to manufacture [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] fighters for Loyalist [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. He also tracked the strike force and sent the ''[[Grappler]]'', an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]], to trap [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Sceltor]]'', in order to kill Thrawn and steal the Warheads for himself.

==Battle==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] arrived with his [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] armed with Mag Pulse warheads to disrupt the ''Grappler's'' weapon systems. As he dogfighted multiple [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], ''RS-32'' was destroyed by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]], then turned onto the ''Sceltor''. Stele wasted no time in intercepting the Bombers, but things got more complicated when a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] [[Serpent (Strike-class)|''Serpent'']] arrived and the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] [[Shadow (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Shadow'']] were closing in on the ''Sceltor''. Stele used his Mag Pulse warhead to hamper the ''Serpent'' and assisted the ''Sceltor'' in destroying the cruiser. Stele then turned his attention to the ''Grappler'' and launched another Mag Pulse warhead which struck the Interdictor. 3 TIE Bombers carrying [[Proton rocket/Legends|Heavy rockets]] were launched from the ''Sceltor'' and fired at the ''Grappler'' destroying it. The remaining fighters turned onto the ''Shadow'' and with the help of Stele's Mag Pulse warhead disabling the frigate's weapon systems destroyed the frigate. Stele then docked in the hanger of the ''Sceltor''.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The newly promoted Admiral Thrawn sends his personal congratulations and wishes that you join him in his efforts to track Zaarin down.|Maarek Stele's debriefing officer|audio=SteleThrawnCongratulations-TF.flac|<ref name="TF:DE" />}}
After this battle, [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was awarded the [[Medal of Dignity]] for successfully holding off [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] attacks against the Empire's [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] production facilities.

However, all plants in the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]] were eventually destroyed. But the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] managed to stand their ground for quite some time, and managed to destroy a portion of Zaarin's forces.

In addition, Thrawn was promoted to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]], and was tasked by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to locate and take out Zaarin, giving Thrawn his best resources, one of which was Maarek Stele.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the mission "Trapped", the sixth mission of the game's eighth tour of campaign, "[[Strategic Warfare]]."

The rank that Thrawn has is unclear. In the briefing he is called "Admiral Thrawn", yet in the debreifing he is declared to be newly promoted "Admiral Thrawn".
